question: What is the culminating recognition in this unfolding of awareness?
premises: There is presentation of the full object stirred by various reflections.
There is awareness of full knowerhood.
This awareness is indeed the Bhairava state.
inference: The culmination of the unfolding is the recognition that full knowerhood, even amid varied reflection, is the Bhairava state.
plain_english: The presentation of the full object stirred by various reflections, together with awareness of full knowerhood, is indeed the Bhairava state.
